title: Qualified Accounts to Contact
summary: Research supplied accounts or discover prospects, cross-check fit and current context, and return verified professional contacts with explicit unknowns.
outcome: A sourced account decision brief with fit evidence, observed pain or triggers, offer-relevance hypotheses, current decision-makers, verified work emails and explicit rejections.
boundary: The Skill does not prove need, budget, timing, buying intent or sales qualification; guarantee the requested yield; infer private emails; send outreach; write to a CRM; or exceed the caller-approved spend ceiling.

catalog_tools.purpose: Discover a bounded candidate pool when no account list is supplied, or resolve missing company identity.
Resolve company identity and find bounded public evidence for hard profile claims.
Extract one selected first-party company page as evidence for fit and identity.
Find a relevant current person and public professional work email for an accepted company.
Verify the selected work email when domain search does not return a sufficiently current valid status.
Confirm the official identity and active status of a UK company when applicable.

inputs: A narrow ideal-customer profile with geography, business type, size and hard exclusions
The offer or problem used to judge company fit
One buyer role or an ordered set of acceptable roles
A target number of accepted prospects and maximum total research spend
Existing customer, suppression and do-not-contact domains
Optional supplied account list and a must-have pain or trigger with freshness window
outputs: Up to the requested number of ranked contact-ready prospects with company fit evidence
One relevant current person and verified professional work email per accepted row
Incomplete and rejected candidates plus a complete research receipt
Reusable human-review artifact with explicit evidence and uncertainty
Observed pain or trigger, offer relevance, contrary evidence and next qualification question for each account

cost.model: One or more bounded company-discovery segments plus public research, one contact search, conditional email verification and an optional official company check per attempted prospect.
cost.notes: Re-inspect and price the exact bounded plan, including minimum billing blocks, discarded candidates and conditional verification. The starter seeks up to five accepted accounts within $0.50 without guaranteeing yield.

approvals: Use existing authorisation covering offer, hard criteria, selection rules, roles, examination limit and maximum cost
Pause for server confirmation or a material change beyond the approved scope or retry allowance
No outreach or CRM write without explicit scope
compatibility: One authorized Scrollport connection with apps, discover, inspect, run and wallet
A local file or conversation state for resumable research and the final receipt
